title: Exparel and Education to Avoid Opioids After Carpal Tunnel Release
official: Exparel and Education to Avoid Opioids After Carpal Tunnel Release
summary: This trial seeks to use the long acting local anesthetic Exparel, in conjunction with opioid education, to attempt to avoid any post-operative opioid use following carpal tunnel surgery. This group will be compared with a "standard" group that receives non-liposomal bupivacaine, opioid education, and opioids.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* carpal tunnel syndrome diagnosed either by physical exam or EMG
* age \>18.

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy to bupivacaine
* pre-operative opioid usage within the last six months
* patients allergic to Percocet or acetaminophen
* patients taking tricyclic antidepressants (interaction with bupivacaine)
* vulnerable populations (prisoners or pregnant women)
